goal: Stakeholder can receive one validated report model for all three report pages and every verdict state.

acceptance_ownership.AC-08: Task 023 owns the lifecycle, six-domain, totals, integrity, freshness, blocker, repair-loop, runtime, kernel, and release-verdict data consumed by overview.html; Task 024 owns its HTML projection.
acceptance_ownership.AC-09: Task 023 owns the complete approved case-contract and domain-coverage projection; Task 025 owns the catalog HTML projection.
acceptance_ownership.AC-10: Task 023 owns immutable runs, attempts, readings, commands, evidence, hashes, freshness, failure, and repair history; Task 025 owns the results HTML projection.
acceptance_ownership.AC-11: Task 023 owns one stable information hierarchy and vocabulary for all eight verdict states; Tasks 024-026 own shared visual components and accessible presentation.
acceptance_ownership.AC-29: Task 023 owns report-model generation for partial, red, blocked, and passing states while keeping JSON and JSONL source artifacts authoritative; Tasks 024-026 own HTML generation.

non_goals: Do not expand beyond this vertical slice or complete dependent tasks implicitly.
Do not add fallback, verification light mode, manual green overrides, or business-project package mutations.
Do not overwrite failed attempts, raw evidence, or unrelated downstream worktree changes.
expected_evidence: A focused failing test or fixture before the implementation change
System-executed command output with exit status
Task report, spec review, and quality review before checkbox completion
Direct evidence for AC-08, AC-09, AC-10, AC-11, AC-29
unsafe_assumptions: Tool availability is not runtime readiness.
Model interpretation is not a deterministic oracle.
Report HTML is not the release gate source.
Legacy V1 status is not V2 proof.
stop_condition: Stop when dependencies 016-six-domain-aggregation, 017-not-applicable-approval, 018-failure-classification, 020-retest-regression-loop, 021-case-freshness are incomplete, scope or contract evidence is missing, a required dependency is unavailable, or shared kernel behavior would be duplicated.
